builder: Anthony Leo / Electronics Australia project ecosystem
model_or_product: A Fuzz Box for Electric Guitar / Playtone Fuzzmaster kit
evidence_summary: Anthony Leo is documented as the author of the August 1967 Electronics Australia fuzz-box project later republished by Popular Electronics in February 1968. Secondary historical research identifies a Playtone Fuzzmaster sold in kit form in Australia using this published design. This is preserved as a published-design/kit ecosystem node, not a confirmed commercial pedal manufacturer, because the reviewed evidence does not establish that Leo or Playtone operated a conventional factory-built pedal line.
